# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Packages
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
packages <- c("nVennR2", "here", "readr", "dplyr", "showtext", "sysfonts")
new_packages <- packages[!packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

library(nVennR2)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(showtext)
library(sysfonts)

# Register Roboto Slab
font_add_google("Roboto Slab", "roboto_slab")
showtext_auto()

# Use Roboto Slab for base graphics
par(family = "roboto_slab")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Import incident-level data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df <- read_csv(
  here("data/csew", "vawg_incident_level.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

vawg_cols <- c(
  "vawg_official_codes",
  "vawg_sex_force_threats",
  "vawg_domestic",
  "vawg_harasm"
)

set_names <- c(
  "Official",
  "Force/threats",
  "Domestic",
  "Harassment"
)

palette <- c(
  "#0b6e4f",
  "#f15bb5",
  "#00bbf9",
  "#ffd100"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare incident-level indicators
# ------------------------------------------------------------

vawg <- df |>
  select(all_of(vawg_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ . %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "True", "true", 1, "1")
  ))

incident_id <- seq_len(nrow(vawg))

sets <- setNames(
  lapply(vawg_cols, \(x) incident_id[vawg[[x]]]),
  set_names
)

totals <- sapply(sets, length)
print(totals)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit free-form nVenn diagram
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sexual-offence definition overlap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sex_cols <- c(
  "vawg_official_codes",
  "whatfo4f",
  "whatfo4g",
  "whatfo4h",
  "v712"
)

sex_names <- c(
  "Official",
  "Rape",
  "Attempted rape",
  "Sexual assault",
  "Sexual element"
)

sex_palette <- c(
  "#0b6e4f",
  "#f15bb5",
  "#00bbf9",
  "#ffd100",
  "#8e6bb8"
)

sex_vawg <- df |>
  select(all_of(sex_cols)) |>
  mutate(
    vawg_official_codes = vawg_official_codes,
    across(
      c(whatfo4f, whatfo4g, whatfo4h, v712),
      ~ grepl("1", as.character(.), fixed = TRUE)
    ),
    vawg_official_codes = vawg_official_codes %in%
      c(TRUE, "TRUE", "True", "true", 1, "1")
  )

incident_id <- seq_len(nrow(sex_vawg))

sex_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(sex_cols, \(x) incident_id[sex_vawg[[x]]]),
  sex_names
)

print(sapply(sex_sets, length))

set.seed(123)

sex_fit <- nVennDiagram(
  sex_sets,
  verbose = FALSE
)

sex_fit <- setVennSkin(
  sex_fit,
  params = list(
    opacity = 0.55,
    lineWidth = 2,
    fontSize = 12,
    fontFamily = "roboto_slab",
    showRegions = FALSE,
    showWeights = TRUE,
    colors = sex_palette
  ),
  plot = FALSE
)

plotVenn(sex_fit)

svg_file <- here("figures", "nvenn_official_sexual_offences.svg")

plotVenn(
  sex_fit,
  outFile = svg_file
)

rsvg::rsvg_png(
  svg_file,
  file = here("figures", "nvenn_official_sexual_offences.png"),
  width = 2400,
  height = 1800
)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)

fit <- nVennDiagram(
  sets,
  verbose = FALSE
)

fit <- setVennSkin(
  fit,
  params = list(
    opacity = 0.55,
    lineWidth = 1.6,
    fontSize = 12,
    fontFamily = "roboto_slab",
    showRegions = FALSE,
    showWeights = TRUE,
    colors = palette
  ),
  plot = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PNG export
# ------------------------------------------------------------

png(
  here("figures", "nvenn_vawg_definitions_1.png"),
  width = 2400,
  height = 1300,
  res = 300,
  bg = "white",
  type = "cairo"
)

par(family = "roboto_slab", mar = c(1, 1, 1, 8))
fit <- setVennSkin(
  fit,
  params = list(
    opacity = 0.55,
    lineWidth = 2,
    fontSize = 12,
    showRegions = FALSE,
    showWeights = TRUE,
    colors = palette
  ),
  plot = FALSE
)

# Display in RStudio
plotVenn(fit)

# Install/load rsvg if needed
if (!requireNamespace("rsvg", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("rsvg")
}

# Export SVG
svg_file <- here("figures", "nvenn_vawg_definition_1.svg")

plotVenn(
  fit,
  outFile = svg_file
)

# Convert SVG to high-resolution PNG
rsvg::rsvg_png(
  svg_file,
  file = here("figures", "nvenn_vawg_definition_1.png"),
  width = 2400,
  height = 1800
)
```
